CommunityApplications.Profile:
**RaisonRed** - Unraid plugins for people who run more than one set of disks in the same server.
- **AADAS - Auto Array Detection & Swap**: detects the installed disk set at boot and applies its array configuration (slots, pools, shares, Custom SMB Shares list), with a verified, rolled-back-on-failure switch.
Support: GitHub issues at https://github.com/RaisonRed/unraid-aadas/issues
